test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Only two people sit between F and K when counted from the right of F. Only two people sit between K and C. Only three people sit between F and D. B sits to the immediate left of G.

Who sits third to the left of E?
solution:
**Given: **B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. 

1) Only two people sit between F and K when counted from the right of F.

2) Only two people sit between K and C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2aba24c8d659899d88197a61b2ad8b449b0a93ed00fbe86b200d074b8aa6901c.png] 

3) Only three people sit between F and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f50469b12f4c9da5a72f2c80cb62d22110042451bf2a971f20b4f9615357a1d2.png] 

4) B sits to the immediate left of G.

After positioning B and G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b75155e3d81698bd9d1475d7e479c4861fca8f0bcecc7f688ddedd9b991ed29.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, G sits third to the left of E.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
